The31-target SP sum corroborates a group wipe; universal uncapped AoE or boss/champion behavior is not established.
79740 is summed HP before the attack, not independently measured skill damage or sustained DPS.
Reward ratios versus preceding pulls are per-fight observations, not measured adena/hour.
Repeated U skill/result tails are not separate casts; only one provoke request exists in the file.
HP6195 at both endpoints does not rule out intermediate damage followed by healing.
No live game requests, runtime changes or profile changes were performed.
Large-pull rewards establish group result, not whether Whirlwind directly hit31 targets or victory processing awarded/finished the rest. No universal target cap derived.
